verdict.rationale: The LM Studio CLI documents loading a model with a custom identifier (`lms load openai/gpt-oss-20b --identifier="my-model-name"`). The product also serves loaded models over OpenAI-like and REST endpoints, so the core of the story is delivered by a first-party, documented capability. However, the evidence only implies that this identifier is the name API requests use; no documentation or example shows it in an API call. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing the identifier used as the model field in API requests, details on identifier persistence or uniqueness across reloads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
